summary_ja: 原本と採用参照を維持し、データの保存区分・持込目録・Unicode別名・再生成キャッシュを整理する記録。

organization.scratch_exclusions: .gitignore excludes only local root scratch and known metadata lock/staging paths; adopted output allowlist is retained.

local_checkpoint.method: Separate temporary index seeded from the base commit; reviewed exact paths, canonical NFC path identities, local commit and new ref only.
local_checkpoint.state_source: Resolve this ref and inspect its tree. The hash of a commit cannot be embedded in its own content. Final local execution receipt is output/data-organization-v001/checkpoint.json.
local_checkpoint.working_branch_note: The current main/index are kept intact for parallel work; git status there can still show untracked/modified paths. The checkpoint ref records the saved tree separately.

retained_open_items.note: Existing four needs_revision and four needs_review batches remain. Organizing and saving them is not visual acceptance.

validation_policy: Validate incoming source SHA/dimensions, current workspace/library/archive, local doc links, unique NFC+casefold paths, required inventory coverage, canonical LFS pointers/local objects, and preservation of real HEAD/index before declaring the checkpoint complete.
